ngo.start.title: Welcome to Capito
ngo.start.tagline: A money game for Grade 11 and 12 students: learn with practice money, see what your choices do, and grow a pretend portfolio.
ngo.start.student.title: I'm a student
ngo.start.student.body: Play the lessons, plan your month and build your money skills.
ngo.start.ngo.title: I'm from an NGO
ngo.start.ngo.body: See how your class is doing: progress, quiz scores and where learners need help.
ngo.start.footer: Practice money and pretend markets. Capito explains how things work; it is not advice.
ngo.header.title: Capito for NGOs
ngo.header.sampleNote: This is a sample class made up for the demo, plus this device as one learner. In the full version the numbers come from your own class.

ngo.privacy.title: Privacy
ngo.privacy.sees1: Nicknames picked by the app, never real names
ngo.privacy.sees2: Lessons finished and first-try quiz scores
ngo.privacy.sees3: First choices in life events and scam alerts
ngo.privacy.sees4: Money Health Score and safety net, in practice money
ngo.privacy.full: In the full version, learners join with a class code and an anonymous sign-in. This demo has no sign-in and sends nothing anywhere.
